description:
This Build Order is  from Vortix's Video on OOTD. 
Please watch his Video for more info.
name: OOTD Fast castle - Vortix's Burg Build
author: taktaktab

notes: All @unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@ and look for @resource/deer.webp@ with @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@
First @unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ that goes to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ builds @building_economy/house.webp@ and @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@
First @unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ that goes to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ builds @building_economy/house.webp@ and @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@
Once we have 3 @unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ we set @resource/rally.webp@ back to @resource/sheep.webp@
once @landmark_hre/aachen-chapel.webp@ is done, move 2 Builder @unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@to @resource/resource_gold.webp@and 1 to @resource/sheep.webp@
Age up wiith 8 @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ and go for @landmark_hre/burgrave-palace.webp@
Once we have  2 @unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ on @resource/sheep.webp@, set @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@
Play the rest of the game and make sure to keep on macro-ing based on your needs.
5 vont sur les @resource/sheep.webp@ puis sur les  @resource/deer.webp@ si possible
2 vont sur @resource/resource_gold.webp@ le premier construit @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ puis @building_economy/house.webp@
2 des @resource/sheep.webp@ vont construire le batiment d'age puis retournera au moutons
3 des @resource/resource_wood.webp@ construit une @building_military/stable.webp@ (maybe @building_military/archery-range.webp@ ?) avant de partir sur @resource/resource_gold.webp@
on fait quand on peut de la cav legere et on va chasser l'ennemi
viser le passage d'age en ayant cependant un peu de cav
apres le passage d'age, on fait une caserne si pas @landmark_hre/burgrave-palace.webp@ et ont fait un mix de arbaletrier et homme d'arme avec un peu de cav lourde si besoin

Go feudal with @landmark_hre/meinwerk-palace.webp@ with 3 @resource/sheep.webp@ @unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ 3 new @unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@
Send the 3 age-up @unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ to long distance gather 40 @resource/resource_stone.webp@ (1 run) and then back to @resource/sheep.webp@
You also send 1 @unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and build a @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ with @technology_defensive/arrow-slits.webp@
For the rest of @age/age_2.webp@ just @resource/rally.webp@ @resource/sheep.webp@ to go @age/age_3.webp@

@building_religious/monastery.webp@ and infantry production. Ideally @unit_dragon/gilded-spearman-1.webp@ + @unit_dragon/gilded-archer-2.webp@(against xbow comps), @unit_dragon/gilded-man-at-arms-2.webp@ + @unit_dragon/gilded-crossbowman-3.webp@ (against knight archer)

@technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@ + @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@ and @unit_hre/prelate.webp@ spam. Start making production buildings at this point. Archery ranges are usually the go to.
@technology_hre/inspired-warriors.webp@ research and then mass army up. Eventually might be worth to add cav to composition as well. Good luck!
5 vont sur les @resource/sheep.webp@ puis sur les  @resource/deer.webp@ si possible
2 vont sur @resource/resource_gold.webp@ le premier construit @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ puis @building_economy/house.webp@
2 des @resource/sheep.webp@ vont construire le batiment d'age puis retournera au mouton
le reste des @resource/sheep.webp@ vont sur @resource/resource_stone.webp@ et @resource/rally.webp@ sur @resource/resource_stone.webp@ jusqu'a 4
a 400 -> @resource/resource_stone.webp@ vont commencer a se placer sur le forum avant d'aller @resource/resource_food.webp@
3 des @resource/resource_wood.webp@ construit une @building_military/stable.webp@ (maybe @building_military/archery-range.webp@ ?) avant de retourner sur @resource/resource_wood.webp@
on fait quand on peut de la cav legere et on va chasser l'ennemi
viser le passage d'age en ayant cependant un peu de cav
@landmark_hre/burgrave-palace.webp@ si tu l'a pas senti avec ta cav
apres le passage d'age, on fait une caserne si pas @landmark_hre/burgrave-palace.webp@ et ont fait un mix de cav lourde,arbaletrier et homme d'arme

description:
Fast Castle with Burgrave from Vortix.
Have fun!
name: Vortix's Fast Burgrave - Copy for me to understand series
author: murtuk

notes: Make 2 @unit_dragon/gilded-spearman-1.webp@ and get VETERAN spears upgrade
After can go to @unit_dragon/gilded-man-at-arms-2.webp@, make more @building_military/archery-range.webp@ etc
When floating gold, research @technology_hre/inspired-warriors.webp@ and keep making @unit_hre/prelate.webp@

name: OOTD FC INTO IMPERIAL GOD BOOM
author: yakov

notes: when @resource/boar.webp@ is find, send all 5 @unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ to it, uses @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ to tank
2 new @unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ go to @resource/resource_gold.webp@, 1 builds @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ and second a HOUSE
Send next 2@unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ close to TC
Take 5 @unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ from @resource/sheep.webp@ and 4 go build @landmark_hre/regnitz-cathedral.webp@ close to @building_economy/town-center.webp@
Insta produces 3@unit_hre/prelate.webp@ on  and send them to take @resource/relics.webp@
Try to make 2 more @unit_dragon/gilded-horseman-2.webp@ to protect reliqs

Send @unit_dragon/gilded-knight-3.webp@ to dive enemys @resource/resource_gold.webp@ or @resource/resource_stone.webp@, try to not die, the unity is very expensive, if he loses life, send him back to heal with @unit_hre/prelate.webp@

Whem u reach 20 @unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@on @resource/resource_food.webp@ and 10 @unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@, @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_wood.webp@ until the end of the game.
take all @resource/sheep.webp@ @unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ and build @landmark_hre/palace-of-swabia.webp@ for the boom
@unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ on @resource/deer.webp@ if scouted really early, build @building_economy/mill.webp@ and tech @technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@

@age/age_2.webp@ with 2 @unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ of @resource/sheep.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ until 3 @unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ then on @resource/resource_food.webp@
when you can build @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ on gold and a @building_economy/house.webp@ change @unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ disposition

take 3 @unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ from @resource/resource_food.webp@ and go on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ +1 @unit_dragon/gilded-villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@
tech @technology_military/military-academy.webp@ when age up is finished
@landmark_hre/regnitz-cathedral.webp@ Only if sure can secure at least 3 @resource/relics.webp@
